arztis.econnector.ihe.model.eimpf.ArztisUpdateImmunizationState
public class ArztisUpdateImmunizationState
extends org.ehealth_connector.cda.at.elga.v2019.cdabuilder.elgaimpf.UpdateImmunizationState
This class is used to pass details to generate a CDA document of the class "Update Immunisierungsstatus". Moreover it can be used to extract details of a CDA document.

      public ArztisUpdateImmunizationState​(org.json.JSONObject json, java.lang.String ownOid) throws java.text.ParseException
      Constructor to generate a CDA document instance ArztisUpdateImmunizationState from a JSON.
      Parameters:
      json - JSON object filled with information for the CDA. The description of the JSON structure you can find under docs/api/v1/cda.md in the section "Update Immunisierungsstatus"
      ownOid - OID of the health care provider, who generated the CDA document. This parameter will be used as default value.
      Throws:
      java.text.ParseException
